epoch: Remine all 764 fixed targets with the full decoder at current weights, then one shuffled pass over every resulting contrast exactly once
surrogate: Mean squared hinge plus 0.1 squared distance from all-one A1 channel weights; reference gates, group shifts and retained plans frozen only within each mining round
fixed_diagnostics: Data-only squared hinge on E00 TRAIN contrasts and one hash-selected eligible target per DEV sentence; fixed examples, contrasts and scale across epochs
selection: Strict safe improvement in full DEV lemma+POS over A3 E00 (the selected A1 E05); fixed 4070-word denominator
safety: DEV declared-feature correctness >= A1 E05; wrong committed lemma decisions <= A1 E05; finite weights/loss, unchanged candidates, complete search, reconstruction, graph and objective checks
controls: Unchanged E70/P9, E21 overfit monitoring, 3 consecutive signals
backup: Two verified V snapshots including A1 weights, A3 weights, optimizer/RNG, fixed probes and audit; retain E00, best and latest two
publication: Per-epoch aggregate GitHub outbox; do not start another epoch until its publication acknowledgement matches the exact four file hashes
TEST_CALIB: Neither opened in A3; no A2 calibration in this trainer
